need: Build a reference for a whole industry, where no single company's hierarchy is the backbone
what_we_did_instead: Built the backbone from peers' public structure and standards, with a decision per L0 to L2 node (DSBP-DEC-0005, 0012 to 0031)
proposed_change: Add an industry-reference mode: the backbone is built from a published standard plus public evidence from 3 or more independent organizations (the default; a build may set its own number), and the owner signs off the top-level backbone nodes (for example L0 to L2), not every node. A seed hierarchy is a starting point only. The skill text names no build's decision IDs; DS_Business_Process appears only as a labelled worked example

need: An evidence order where standards drive the design and peers only validate it; the organization's own documents are not tier 1
what_we_did_instead: Recorded our own order (DSBP-DEC-0002)
proposed_change: In industry-reference mode only (single-organization builds keep today's order): 1. standards and sector bodies, 2. public disclosures of 3 or more independent organizations, 3. sector-specific sources, 4. generic frameworks, as a crosswalk only, except that a framework may fill a naming gap where the item is tied to work practitioners are shown to do. Private organization material may show what exists but is never cited

need: Split what belongs in the reference from what belongs to a company
what_we_did_instead: Decided the split for measures and RACI (DSBP-DEC-0033)
proposed_change: State the two layers. The reference holds definitions, public formulas that are the same everywhere (no organization's own formula), each measure's nature and roles (the typical-KPI role included), driver links, and typical RACI by generic role. An organization's specialization holds KPI designations with targets, thresholds and owners, its own formulas and formula versions, its role titles mapped to the generic roles, named assignments, internal systems and instances. Clean-room rule: nothing internal to an organization appears anywhere in the reference, not as a label, a hidden label, a definition or an example

need: Typical RACI by generic role, from public evidence, where no company RACI is the source
what_we_did_instead: Not yet built
proposed_change: Add rules for reference RACI: generic roles come from a public occupational, governance or regulatory standard (for example O*NET-SOC, ISCO-08, ESCO, ISO management-system standards, sector rules) or from 3 or more independent organizations; each assignment cites its evidence; a role from one jurisdiction's rule is marked with that jurisdiction; rule 8 (infer nothing from the hierarchy) still holds

need: Review rules for candidate relations such as "enables" mined from documents
what_we_did_instead: Derived five rules from the 1.2 Step 4 review file: an enables that restates an output dependency is merged; one that hides a sequence becomes precedes; child-to-ancestor is part-of, rejected; same-parent links are stronger evidence; explicit text reference outranks structural nearness
proposed_change: Add generic review rules for any relation mined from documents, each with the evidence level it gives: an enables link that restates an output dependency is merged into that dependency; one that hides a sequence becomes precedes, subject to SG-12; a child-to-ancestor link duplicates the hierarchy and is rejected; an explicit text reference outranks structural nearness.
